directions.name: Poudre Settling Stipple Field
directions.brief: 把扑粉的下坠读作一张点刻画：平涂深橄榄 Moss 卡纸上，细密骨白粉点自顶带向下逐级稀薄如粉雾沉降，在下三分之一处被一道硬边留白横带截断，如同粉尘落定；一枚低不透明度橄榄矩形板沉于点场之后托住剪影下半，点阵从其肩后继续垂落却不触碰标签。商品沉于下幅立于点场心与留白带之前，奶油漆芯的柔体积对抗点密度的平面下坠。顶带留出完全安静的铭牌区：宽距 Arial 品牌字最小置顶，Bodoni 题名以近满幅宽的单行 Didone 大字居中统领，副行垫底，一条粉白细线横垫其下如沉降零点——题名整组结束于瓶顶之上，构成 ABOVE 纪念碑网格。无地面无 horizon，纯点密度叙事。参考 R1 的铭牌层级（品牌轻、题名重、副行垫底）、R4 的中心聚焦秩序与 R6 的柔光粉彩温度。
directions.material: flat matte silkscreen-printed card with fine stipple powder-dot density gradient and one hard-edge blank plaque band
directions.lighting: perfectly even shadowless frontal illumination, flat graphic ink light with no falloff
directions.background_prompt: Seamless flat matte silkscreen-printed card in deep olive moss green, fine bone-white stipple powder dots dense at the top edge thinning gradually downward, one hard-edge blank horizontal band without dots across the lower third, perfectly even shadowless frontal illumination, no texture gradients beyond printed dots, no objects

directions.name: Chalk Powder Sift Morning
directions.brief: 把奶油漆芯的柔光放进一间晨间粉筛工坊：冷调浅白垩灰泥墙在真实基准线处接连续 honed 同料白垩地面，高键晨光自左上洒下一团宽而静的粉白光晕，墙地交界保持哑光矿物颗粒；商品缩小立于白垩地偏右，测量接触阴影轻陷进磨面。左半幅墙保持安静冷白，承载一根真正的左栏排印：宽距 Arial 品牌字居柱顶，Arial Narrow 题名以窄柱两行大字排印如筛粉签条，副行与一条石蓝细线横垫柱底如筛网刻度。文字柱垂直方向与盖肩重叠、水平方向宽距分离，双栏编辑网格诚实成立，构成 BESIDE 关系；白垩的冷哑光与象牙芯的暖柔互为温度悖论。参考 R2 的分区铭牌秩序、R3 的高键硬净负空间与 R7 的柔光渐变背景秩序。
directions.material: pale cool chalk plaster wall sweeping into continuous honed chalk ground
directions.lighting: soft high-key morning light with one broad calm powder-white glow from upper left, diffuse frontal matching the baked softbox key, no hard shadows
directions.background_prompt: Pale cool chalk plaster wall in soft powder white-beige meeting a continuous honed matching chalk ground at a horizontal horizon seventy-two hundredths down the frame, one broad calm powder-white glow blooming from upper left, matte mineral grain, soft high-key diffuse illumination, no objects

directions.name: Musk Velvet Twilight Column
directions.brief: 把粉雾的夜幕读作一面天鹅绒幕：中调灰蓝绒面自墙垂落并在真实基准线处折成连续同料绒地，绒毫在暮光里保持低亮哑光；商品立于绒地偏左，测量接触阴影陷进绒毫。右半幅绒面保持安静深灰蓝，承载一根真正的右栏排印：宽距 Arial 品牌字居柱顶，Times 题名以窄柱两行衬线大字排印如织边签条，副行与一条骨白细线横垫柱底如暮色刻度。文字柱垂直方向与盖肩重叠、水平方向宽距分离，双栏编辑网格诚实成立，构成 BESIDE 关系；绒面的吸光哑光与透明玻璃边的细折光互为虚实。参考 R1 的右栏负空间排印层级、R5 的柔光氛围与 R8 的深色纪念碑负空间。
directions.material: deep dusty blue velvet cloth wall sweeping into continuous matching velvet ground
directions.lighting: soft diffuse twilight ambient with one gentle broad sheen drift low on the cloth, frontal fill matching the baked softbox key, no hard shadows
directions.background_prompt: Medium dusty blue velvet cloth hanging as a soft wall and sweeping into a continuous matching velvet ground at a horizontal horizon seventy-four hundredths down the frame, fine low nap grain with one gentle broad sheen drift low on the cloth, soft diffuse twilight illumination, no objects

directions.name: Powder-Press Ledger Slabs
directions.brief: 把压粉工序读作三级压模：平涂暖灰褐卡纸上，三枚硬边骨白矩形压板自左上向右下逐级错叠如粉饼压模剖面，板缘一道斜向留白缝精确平行瓶肩斜线；商品提至中上幅立于压板之前，矩形从其肩后掠过却不触碰标签。下幅留出完整宽铭牌带，题名整组起排于瓶底之下，构成 BELOW 关系：宽距 Arial 品牌字居带顶，Century Gothic 几何大写题名以两行宽排收左缘起排，副行垫底，一条褐灰细线横垫区底如压模刻度。无地面无 horizon，纯板阶几何对抗奶油漆芯的柔体积。参考 R2 的纸面分区秩序、R4 的几何背景层次与 R6 的高键粉彩秩序。
directions.material: flat matte screen-printed card with hard-edge stacked bone rectangle press slabs and one oblique blank seam
directions.lighting: perfectly even shadowless frontal illumination, flat graphic ink light with no falloff
directions.background_prompt: Seamless flat matte screen-printed card in warm taupe grey, three hard-edge flat bone-white rectangle slabs stacked obliquely from upper left toward lower right with one thin blank taupe seam between slab edges, perfectly even shadowless illumination, no texture gradients, no objects
